items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: Otis would be playing the first trumpet... they started marking the music, the arranger would start marking the music, 'Henry Allen' or 'Otis Johnson,' 'Charlie Holmes'...

ctx.x: So now you've got Otis Johnson working with Henry Allen, then.
Red was in the band when Otis came in? I can't remember. Yeah, it's possible. Sure.
What do you remember of Otis?
